title: Sub-100,000 Qubit Fault-Tolerant Error-Correction & Circuit Overhead Drop
whyItMatters: New qLDPC error-correction codes and AI-optimized circuits slash the physical qubits needed for cryptographically relevant quantum computing from 20M (2019) to under 100,000.
summary: A rapid succession of algorithmic and quantum error-correction advances between 2025 and 2026—combining high-rate quantum LDPC codes, magic-state cultivation, and AI-guided circuit synthesis—cut resource estimates for factoring RSA-2048 from ~20 million physical qubits in 2019 to under 1 million in 2025 and below 100,000 physical qubits in 2026. This 200× software/math compression accelerated global enterprise and government post-quantum migration targets to 2029.
technicalHighlights: Achieves a ~200× reduction in physical qubit requirements in seven years primarily through mathematics, codes, and circuit compilation rather than raw hardware scale.
Combines magic-state distillation alternatives with low-overhead qLDPC architectures.
Prompted major cloud, financial, and infrastructure providers to pull post-quantum cryptography deadlines forward to 2029.
caveats: Resource estimates assume physical gate error rates and non-local qubit connectivity that still pose formidable hardware engineering challenges at 100,000-qubit scale.
